summary: Retain exact tested Git objects as non-required CI source receipts

schema.detail: No daemon schema change; the CI artifact has a versioned JSON receipt.

compatibility.detail: Workspace CI gains an optional source artifact naming its effective checkout rather than the PR author head. Existing required checks and merge queue behavior are unchanged.

manual.detail: No operator action or signing key is required to retain source receipts.

recovery.detail: A failed or absent source receipt supplies no evidence; existing CI proceeds and no gate is authorized. Artifacts retain synthetic merge objects for 14 days.
